openSql.query: insert into "questpie_realtime_topology" ("session_key", "owner_id", "owner_generation", "protocol_version", "token_hash", "identity_hash", "lease_expires_at", "desired_revision", "applied_revision", "desired_topology", "created_at", "updated_at") values ($1, $2, default, $3, $4, $5, now() + ($6 * interval $10), $7, $8, $9, default, default) returning "session_key", "owner_id", "owner_generation", "protocol_version", "token_hash", "identity_hash", "lease_expires_at", "desired_revision", "applied_revision", "desired_topology", "created_at", "updated_at"
